QuestInfo.name: The Maple Administrator's Package
QuestInfo.1: The #bMaple Administrator#k asked for an item from Gold Richie, but due to a monster attack, the container with the item, #b#t4032803##k, has been lost. Retrieve #b#t4032803##k from the monsters.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the package to the Maple Administrator, all the time wondering what was inside.

0.0: Oh, you're the one Gold Richie sent. I've been waiting for you. This is so important to me, I have to send it back today.
0.1: Thank you for the delivery. Isn't #bMaple Admin#k next? Hurry! You have to deliver it by the end of the day!

1.0: This is the item I asked Gold Richie for! Thank you for bringing it to me. I have to send it right away...

yes.0: I had heard that it was lost in a monster attack... Thank you so much!
